entries.zh: 救急；解救危急、紧急救助
entries.en: to relieve urgent distress; emergency aid, rescue in a crisis

entries.zh: 救助危难、解救受困之人
entries.en: to succor the imperiled or distressed (character doubtful; sense inferred from the 'socorrer' frame)
entries.notes: 「救繫」不成常词，音写 quin 与「繫」常读不合，或为「饑/窘/緊」类俗写，释义依西栏 socorrer 与「救」字推断。

entries.zh: 赈济；以财物救济贫困、灾荒
entries.en: to relieve the needy with money or goods; alms, disaster relief
entries.notes: 「跟濟」不成词，音写 chin chey 与「賑濟」吻合，按「賑濟」释义。

entries.zh: 救济危急、济急救难
entries.en: to relieve urgency and rescue the distressed (characters partly doubtful)
entries.notes: 「繫」字存疑同第2条，「急」系行旁添字，释义依「濟/急」与西栏推断。

entries.zh: 周济急难；救济陷入急困者
entries.en: to relieve those in urgent need (classical compound zhou-ji 周急, succor of the distressed)

entries.zh: 周济；以财物接济贫困者
entries.en: to relieve the poor with money or goods; charitable aid

entries.zh: 疼痛；身体的痛楚
entries.en: pain, ache; to hurt
entries.notes: 西栏 So correr tener la última 与「疼痛」义不谐，疑串行误接或误读，释义依「痛疼」与音写 tia tay 定。

entries.zh: 疼痛；痛楚
entries.en: pain, ache; to hurt
entries.notes: 同上条，西栏语义异常，依「疼痛」与音写 tay tia 定释义。

entries.zh: 恤贫；救济贫困者、抚恤贫民
entries.en: to relieve or pity the poor; almsgiving to the needy

entries.zh: 救险难；解救危难险困
entries.en: to rescue from danger and distress

entries.zh: 口粮；（尤指士兵的）口粮、军粮配给
entries.en: rations, provisions; food allowance, especially soldiers' rations

entries.zh: 济世；救助世人、济世利人
entries.en: to succor or benefit the world; to aid mankind

entries.zh: 助战；出兵助战、协力作战
entries.en: to aid in battle; military assistance, support with troops

entries.zh: 义民；义勇之民、义军（非常备兵员）
entries.en: righteous volunteers, loyal militia (non-regular fighting men)
entries.notes: 西栏「fuera」被划删属誊写者改动，不碍汉字释义。

entries.zh: 阴兵；阴间鬼兵、冥兵
entries.en: ghost soldiers, troops of the netherworld; doubtful — the damaged Spanish margin note reads like 'succor of soldiers in war' (i.e. reinforcements)
entries.notes: 左缘连写补注部分污损且西语残句难解，「陰兵」与 socorro de soldados en la guerra 对不拢，义难定夺。

entries.zh: 阴德；暗中行善积德
entries.en: hidden merit, secret virtue; charity done unobserved
entries.notes: 承上条污损补注，西栏无独立语义，依「陰德」本义释义。

entries.zh: 勒马收缰；控缰使马放缓或止步
entries.en: to rein in or check a horse; bridle-rein control (sofrenar al caballo)
entries.notes: 「消韁」字面为松弛缰绳，与西语 sofrenar（勒缰）方向相反，疑俗写或误读，释义从西栏马术语境。

entries.zh: 缆绳；绳索（海船缆索，亦有缠绕义）
entries.en: rope, cord; nautical line or cable

entries.zh: 疑「壖」：滨河淤滩之地；与「soga, numeral」义不合，释义存疑
entries.en: doubtful: tentatively read as 壖 (riverside waste land); mismatches the Spanish 'soga, numeral' (probably a classifier entry for rope) — gloss withheld
entries.notes: 字有[疑]、音写 chue 与之不谐、西语 numeral 义未落实，三栏互不相谐无从定夺。

entries.zh: 条；绳索等细长物的量词；亦指枝条、细长之物
entries.en: 條: measure word for long thin things (ropes, cords, strips); also a strip or twig
entries.notes: 音写 ios 一字不明，「numeral」按旧辞书量词条目惯例解读为配 soga（绳）的量词。
